plugins.name: streamingo-anonymize
plugins.description: Blur faces in video and images and anonymize the audio, without leaving the conversation: pick a project, submit a job, track it, share the result. Requires a Streamingo Anonymize account.

skills.name: anonymizing-media
skills.description: Use when someone wants to blur or redact faces in a video or image, de-identify or GDPR-proof footage, remove PII from a recording, or asks what Streamingo Anonymize accepts, what it does to audio, what it costs, or whether it can identify people.
headings: Compliance — useful, but say it accurately
skills.description_zh: 使用 Streamingo Anonymize 处理视频或图片中的人脸模糊、遮盖和去身份化，移除录像中的个人身份信息，并解释支持的输入、音频处理、费用及是否识别人。适用于隐私处理及产品能力咨询，合规效果须按实际处理结果核验。
